narrative.northStar: La tarjeta flota, el panel respira
narrative.overview: SearchRideScreen is a map-first screen: the map fills the viewport and a draggable bottom sheet carries the whole form (route, vehicle, features, summary, CTA). The sheet has two states — collapsed peek (compact summary + CTA always visible) and expanded (max 68% of viewport) — animated with a physical spring (damping 26, stiffness 300) and a 44×5 handle. Inside the panel there is no shadow or colored-border hierarchy: selection is expressed only through background tints (surface/inputBg wash on the card, brass accentSoft on icons, pills and active chips). Depth comes from alternating two neutrals (surface vs card), never from elevation.
keyCharacteristics: Selection = tint, never border nor prominent check
Two alternating neutrals nest controls; hairline dividers only
Single action color: brass #b38737 in three intensities (strong, soft, border)
Large radii: 11–24px by container level, plus 999 pills

rules.name: The Tinted Selection Rule
rules.body: A selected state never gains a visible border or big checkmark: it gains background. Card -> inputBg; icon bubble -> accentSoft; feature chip -> accentSoft + accentBorder. The option-card border stays permanently 1.5px transparent so selection causes no layout shift.

rules.name: The Two-Neutral Rule
rules.body: To nest a control inside the panel, invert the neutrals: a surface track holds card-colored buttons (counter, mode chips, meta pills). A third gray is forbidden; if surface is not enough, use accentSoft.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: Every visible digit (price, ETA minutes, passenger count, multipliers) uses fontVariant tabular-nums. A price that jitters while updating is a visual bug.

rules.name: The No-Shadow-Inside Rule
rules.body: Zero shadows inside the sheet except the iOS micro-shadow on the selected mode chip. If an element seems to need elevation, what it needs is surface/card contrast or accentSoft.

dos: Do express selection with background washes (inputBg, accentSoft); the check is a detail, not the mechanism
Do keep card borders transparent at fixed 1.5px for zero layout shift on select
Do use hairline (StyleSheet.hairlineWidth) to separate the expanded zone from the card header
Do auto-size chips to content (min/max-width), never truncate on fixed width
Do apply fontVariant tabular-nums to every digit
donts: Don't add shadows inside the sheet; use surface/card alternation or accentSoft
Don't put the brass accent on long body text or on non-card/surface backgrounds
Don't introduce a second action color inside the panel; warning/success are for real states only
Don't create a third neutral; lacking contrast is a structure problem, not a palette problem
Don't render separators thicker than hairline inside cards
